k1a.say: Your call is important to us.

k1b.say: Did you know? FlexZone members who visit live longer.

k4.say: To cancel your membership, say: cancel.

z6.say: Dale Krupnik! Do NOT finish that word.

d8.say: Forty-seven minutes! If this call drops, I swear to God...

z9.say: I am Zeth, Prime Auditor of the Galactic Reserve. Nine trillion beings need you to keep that membership.

d10.say: It's thirty-five bucks a month. I don't even go.

q12.say: Eleven years, zero visits! But every Sunday night, you sincerely intend to start Monday. Five hundred and seventy-three Mondays in a row!

z14.say: Every currency needs something that never changes. We tried gold. We tried the speed of light... which turned out to be negotiable. Then, we found you.

q15.say: You're more stable than the proton! Protons decay eventually. You are never going to do anything!

d16.say: Okay, hey. I wrestled in high school.

z19.say: The pensions of forty thousand worlds, Mister Krupnik, are stored in your thighs.

d20.say: So... what's that worth to you?

z21.say: Name it. A moon. A sun. Immortality.

d22.say: I want the good parking spot at work. The one by the door.

d24.say: And I want Greg to know I got it.

b29.say: DALE! Brad, from FlexZone! Your free training session, mate! You booked it in twenty-fourteen, and tonight's the night!

q32.say: He's a short seller! He's bet everything that you'll improve!

b35.say: Dale. Mate. I believe in you. One push-up. One push-up, and you're a whole new man.

z36.say: One push-up, and the currency breaks.

d37.say: What do I get if I do it?

b38.say: Abs. Self-respect. Your father's approval... retroactively.

d44.say: You think I don't know? I know I'm never going. I've known since twenty-fifteen. I pay thirty-five bucks a month so I don't have to say it out loud.

z45.say: That is the most beautiful prospectus I have ever heard.

q46.say: I'm putting my mom's savings in him.

d47.say: Well. Not tonight. Tonight, I'm doing one push-up.

q49.say: He's going down! Andromeda just halted trading!

d50.say: Getting down here... is already cardio.

b51.say: Down and up, Dale! Down and up!

k52.say: Your call is important to us.

d53.say: Oh, hey. That's where the remote went.

d54a.say: You know what? It's actually really nice down here.

q55.say: The peg holds! He did nothing! He did nothing, for all of us!

b57.say: No. No, no, no! I'm leveraged forty to one on his glutes!

s58.say: Dale. Did you cancel the gym?

s60.say: I swear, Dale. One more thing, and I'm leaving.

q61.say: She's said that... four thousand times.
